rules.description: Blueprint 9.2: policy, rules, roles, approvers, audit, kill switch, permissions and prompts are not changed through action envelopes by default. Agents and services are also denied by a built-in invariant.
Blueprint 9.2: L0-L1 reads are autonomous within scope. Scope is a built-in check.
Humans read security data through a governance role. Employees do not (blueprint 9.3).
Blueprint 9.2: L2 coordination is autonomous within scope and only to approved channels. Channel approval is a built-in check (G13).
Security administrators and system owners may coordinate within their scope.
Blueprint 9.1, 9.2, OD-15: agents and services may run L3 only under an approved, enabled, unexpired playbook. The playbook gate is a built-in invariant; none ship.
Humans may trigger an active L3 playbook only as security administrator or system owner. Employees and auditors may not.
Blueprint 9.2: agents and services may propose L4 actions; each needs approval by a system owner or executive risk owner in the initial release.

Humans may raise an L4 request only as security administrator or system owner, through a grant that reaches the target; approval comes from a system owner or executive risk owner, and the approvals module refuses self-approval (G33).
